items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Willie Rodriguez used to hang out there, a lot of great musicians used to hang out at Jim & Andy’s.

ctx.x: So people would call down there—

People would call down there and say, “We need a sax player” or, “we need a trombone player,” “we need a trumpet player.” Whatever they needed. Willie Rodriguez used to hang out there, a lot of great musicians used to hang out at Jim & Andy’s.
And all this stuff was tied in to the union too, right?
